declarations.docstring: The functor obtained by tensoring with a fixed right module preserves addition on morphisms.
The additive-group-valued functor on left modules formed by fixing a right module tensor factor.
The auxiliary morphism associated to a linear map between left modules.
The additive homomorphism on the tensor construction induced by a linear map in the left-module factor.
On a pure tensor, the induced homomorphism applies the linear map to the left-module entry.
The morphism on a specified degree of the auxiliary construction induced by a linear map.
